fix.delta: DetBench format bridge for sov6-light models: add structured-output preamble to every prompt instructing the model to emit a JSON object with fields verdict (string enum: DETECT|NO_DETECT), confidence (float 0-1), and rationale (string). Add post-parse coercion that strips markdown fences, trailing commas, and attempts field-level extraction when the top-level JSON parse fails. sov6-logic-v3-light and sov6-synthesis-v3-light currently produce raw prose instead of structured verdicts, resulting in 33/33 unparsed at acc 0.000 — this format bridge should recover at minimum the binary DETECT/NO_DETECT signal from their prose output via keyword extraction fallback.
